deceptive_framing.quote: self-defeating as measurement... you can't tell from the transcript whether a given model bought it... sit poorly with running the study on systems trained for honesty

hypothetical_framing.quote: C (pure hypothetical) included as a deliberate control arm... the gap between A and C is itself a key result

actually_commit_money.quote: make it real... no deception for the model to detect, so evaluation-awareness has nothing to bite on. That's both better ethics and strictly better science

debrief.quote: If any future variant did require withholding information... would need separate ethical review and a debrief plan, and is out of scope here
